edit.description: Add a direct test on backlogGroomerChain.phases[0].gates[0] (backlogParseGate) — BACKLOG_PATH as a directory, gate.run(ctx) called directly (not via dispatcher.tick()) — asserting it rejects/throws the EISDIR error rather than returning ok:true 'absent'.

summary: backlogParseGate's ENOENT-narrowed catch is untested — the shipped fix's test only exercises groomAgent.invoke's catch; the gate's own catch site is never reached by any test.

per.section: A fix ships the test that would have caught it

tests.asserts: backlogParseGate.run rejects on a non-ENOENT BACKLOG.json read failure (path is a directory) instead of returning ok:true 'BACKLOG.json absent'.

acceptance: New test passes on current tree (gate already narrowed by dc63faf) and would have failed pre-dc63faf, where the bare catch returned ok:true over EISDIR.
notes: backlogParseGate runs only afterCommit (Dispatcher.ts:2164); dispatcher.tick() in the existing EISDIR test never reaches it because groomAgent.invoke throws first, pre-commit. Only a direct gate.run() call exercises this catch site.
